churn_resistance.rationale: Excellent layering (HTTP → data builders → server functions → typed view models → components) means framework or data-source changes stay local, and there's no reliance on internals or undocumented behavior. The main gap is the untyped `any`-heavy API-parsing layer, plus small duplications that would ripple across five routes if the title rule changed.

findings.issue: NotFound sets its document title via useEffect + document.title, which never runs during SSR and bypasses the declarative head() API used everywhere else.
findings.suggestion: Provide the not-found title declaratively via the root route's head (or a notFoundHead route option) so it renders on the server like every other page.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled anchor scrolling with requestAnimationFrame + a 150 ms setTimeout duplicates behavior the router provides natively.
findings.suggestion: Enable scrollRestoration: true in createRouter (as in the current start-basic example) and drop the effect.

findings.issue: The API-parsing layer is untyped: record fields are read off `any` with optional chaining throughout, so upstream data-shape changes fail silently at runtime.
findings.suggestion: Define lightweight interfaces for the handful of PokeAPI records consumed (species, pokemon, type, move, ability) and parse into them once; the view-model types are already good.

findings.issue: idFromUrl hand-rolls URL parsing with a regex.
findings.suggestion: Use new URL(url, apiBase()).pathname (or at minimum parse once with URL) instead of a bespoke regex.

findings.issue: Search input navigates on every keystroke with no debounce; the spec allows up to 300 ms, and each keystroke currently triggers a history-replacing navigation.
findings.suggestion: Debounce ~200-300 ms before pushing the URL update (keeping the URL as the filter store).

findings.issue: The `– Pokédex` title template is copy-pasted in five route files (index, pokemon/$name, moves/$name, abilities/$name, types/$name, types/index).
findings.suggestion: Extract a pageTitle() helper so the spec's title rule lives in one place.

findings.issue: defaultPreload: false disables link preloading entirely and scrollRestoration is not enabled, unlike the current recommended router config.
findings.suggestion: Consider defaultPreload: 'intent' and scrollRestoration: true; document why preloading is disabled if the server-fn cost makes it deliberate.

findings.issue: apiList builds its request with a hardcoded `?limit=100000` string.
findings.suggestion: Use URLSearchParams for query construction so adding pagination or caching params later is trivial.

summary: This app is notably forward-looking: it targets the just-stabilized TanStack Start stack (Start 1.169.4, Router 1.170.46, Vite 8, nitro/vite) and consistently uses the current-generation APIs — canonical .validator() server functions, getRouter() registration, notFound(), loaderDeps and loaderData-driven head — with a minimal, modern dependency set. Its main risks are the untyped `any`-heavy API boundary and two imperative useEffect workarounds (document.title on 404, hash scrolling) that fight the framework's declarative facilities. A small cleanup pass would make upgrades nearly touch-free.
